information: 横浜大会2017は，横浜駅徒歩10分の会場にて，3x3x3キューブ3ラウンド，4x4x4キューブ2ラウンドのほか，片手，足，スクエア1競技を開催します。 Yokohama 2017 includes 3x3x3 (3 rounds), 4x4x4 (2 rounds), 3x3x3 One-handed, 3x3x3 with feet and Square-1 as its events. Feel free to ask us about our competition! kanto@jrca.cc Limited to 120 competitors
